China Ratchets Up Its Weaponization of Trade

Brahma Chellaney

Just as the US has been leveraging its large market and technological leadership for geopolitical ends, China is now using its dominance in critical minerals, industrial inputs, and specialized manufacturing machinery to coerce and punish other countries. The consequences, both economic and geopolitical, are far-reaching.

Tang Ke/VCG via Getty Images

Nov 19, 2026
5 min read

BERLIN—For years, the United States has been using export controls to limit China’s access to advanced technologies. China has repeatedly denounced these measures as “blatant” attempts by the US to strengthen its own “technological hegemony,” arguing that the entire strategy runs “contrary to the principles of market economy.” At the same time, however, China has been steadily building its capacity to retaliate.
